text: Lord Nicholas Buzan is one of the unique paladins in the Warcraft III World Editor's toybox. He is not one of the random hero names. In the single-player campaigns, his model is used for both Gavinrad the Dire and Duke Lionheart. Both he and Halahk the Lifebringer use the same model but in separate model files. A character named Buzan the Fearless could randomly appear in the main campaign or in multiplayer maps. They may be different characters.
__NOTOC__ Lord Darkscythe is a rare skeleton located in the Fungal Vale in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Lord Angler can be found in Tidefury Cove in Dustwallow Marsh.
.]] Lord Sakrasis is a rare naga found in the Cape of Stranglethorn standing in front of the Holy Spring at Nek'mani Wellspring.
__NOTOC__ Lorekeeper Kildrath is a night elf found in the library in Dire Maul West.

__NOTOC__ Lorekeeper Mykos is a night elf located in the library in Dire Maul West. Following the Fourth War, she made a donation to the archives of the Sanctum of Light by removing the Athenaeum mark of the book The Light and How to Swing It, written by Uther for Arthas, so that all paladins of the Silver Hand can read it.

__NOTOC__ Lorekeeper Javon is a night elf located in the library in Dire Maul North. To reach the library, enter Dire Maul north, go down into the courtyard and down through the locked door on the left. At the end of the long corridors is the library.
Loramus Thalipedes is a night elf demon hunter and a quest giver during the Blasted Lands storyline that revolves around putting an end to the dreadlord Razelikh the Defiler.
This is part of the main Blasted Lands quest chain, although it takes place in Azshara.
Lorax is a satyr located who is located at bottom of Frostwhisper Gorge, having moved from his prior position in the ruins of a night elven temple on the southeastern ridge of Frostwhisper Gorge.
__NOTOC__ Lord Saltheril is a blood elf quest giver located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods. He is elegant, polished, impeccably tailored, and blessed with a perfect physique.

__NOTOC__ Lord Crispin Ference is one of the Nobles of Darkshire and part of the Moroes encounter of Karazhan. He is a protection warrior and of the six possible adds that spawn with Moroes. During Return to Karazhan: Master of the House, Crispin was set free along with the other guests. After Butler to the Great, Moroes has a chance to generate a Dinner Invitation that can summon him after returning from missions.
Lord Sakrasis' Scepter dropped from Lord Sakrasis in Stranglethorn Vale prior to Cataclysm.

__NOTOC__ Lord Sanguinar is one of the four blood elf advisors that aid Kael'thas during the boss encounter in the Eye. He appears to be a paladin. Kael'thas refers to him by the title "The Blood Hammer".
Lord Blackwood's Blade dropped from Lord Blackwood in Scholomance during the Scourge Invasions. Back in during the WotLK run up.
Lord Blackwood's Buckler dropped from Lord Blackwood in Scholomance.
Lord Illidan Stormrage is the second of the three storyline quests, available starting at reputation with Netherwing.

The Lordaeron Corps was a detachment of troops within the Human Expedition that were led by Jaina Proudmoore to Kalimdor. They were made up of Lordaeronian people. A base of the Corps was wiped out by the Horde.

__NOTOC__ Lord Gregor Lescovar was a human located in the Stormwind Library. He was a high ranking member of the House of Nobles. He secretly worked with the Defias Brotherhood and could be exposed by players on a quest chain. He was also under suspicion of being a contact for the Twilight's Hammer. He had an employee known only as Marzon. Both were killed, thanks to the effort of Tyrion, his spybot and the adventurer, on the orders of Elling Trias.
Lord Grayson's Satchel is provided as an objective for Judgment and Redemption.
Lord Robin Daris is one of the Nobles of Darkshire and part of the Moroes encounter of Karazhan. He is an arms warrior and one of the six possible adds that spawn with Moroes.

Lordaeron Fighters were Forsaken ghosts that could spawn at the various scout towers in the Eastern Plaguelands. Four of them spawned with a Lordaeron Veteran once the Horde captured a tower in the A Game of Towers PvP event.

in the TCG.]] Lord Admiral is the official title of the ruler of Kul Tiras. The Lord Admiral commands the Kul Tiran fleet and rules the nation in a similar fashion to a monarch. They are accompanied by the Admiral's Elite Guard. All known Lord Admirals have been from House Proudmoore. Lady Priscilla Ashvane, once Katherine Proudmoore's advisor and close friend, nearly acquired the position through an elaborate scheme to portray Katherine as being unable to protect the people of Kul Tiras. However, Taelia Fordragon and an Alliance emissary thwarted Ashvane's plan by revealing the deception just moments after Katherine announced that she was stepping down.
The Lorekeeper's Staff is PvP reward item for the Alliance from the Silverwing Sentinels.
__NOTOC__ Lord Klaq is a marsh beast located on the bottom of the Funggor Cavern in Zangarmarsh.
Lord Xiz is a naga found at Wrathscale Lair in Bloodmyst Isle.

Lopeppeppy Sprocket Erth'algos is a Gnome rogue from the Argent Dawn server. Her exploits include: * Being a former [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?forumId=11114 UI & Macros forum] MVP. * Not being laid waste by Cogwheel. * Managing her guild and her Zoo, in no particular order. "The scripting interface has no access to the internet, by design. WoW runs inside of a closed box, internets don't get in and internets don't leak out." --Lopeppeppy
Lord Raadan is one of several potential adds in the Hex Lord Malacrass encounter in Zul'Aman. He casts Thunderclap and Flame Breath and can be slept. He is a red dragonspawn.

__NOTOC__ The Lord of Frost's Private Label is one of the brews of the month you receive from joining with "Brew of the Month" Club Membership Form. It can also be found in the loot chest of the Midsummer Fire Festival boss .
__NOTOC__ Lord Kyrxix is a crypt lord commanding the nerubians tunneling under the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra.
Lorekeeper Randvir is a frost giant quest giver located in Storm Peaks.
Lord-Commander's Nullifier is provided for The Admiral Revealed.

__NOTOC__ Lord-Commander Arete is a Forsaken death knight located at Death's Rise and Onslaught Harbor in Icecrown. He is affiliated with the Knights of the Ebon Blade. Arete gives the player quests which involve taking out the Scarlet Onslaught in Icecrown. He appears to have a deep hatred against the Scarlet Crusade and feels that, even though they might help the Ebon Blade in the battle against the Lich King, they are unworthy to exist.
The Lordaeron Brigade was a detachment of troops within the Human Expedition that were led by Jaina Proudmoore to Kalimdor. They were made up of Lordaeronian people.
wearing the pelt]] Loque'Nahak's Pelt is a cloak that drops from Loque'nahak. Additionally, skinners can also take the pelt from the creature by way of their craft.
Loque'Nahak's Severed Fang is a necklace that drops exclusively from .
A lore location is a place mentioned in the lore, but not present in World of Warcraft.

Lord Walden's Top Hat is a quest reward from Betrayal at Tempest's Reach in the worgen starting zone. It is one of several "named" hats in the game (Don Rigoberto's Lost Hat and Mirren's Drinking Hat being two others).
The Lordbane Scepter is a quest reward from Disrupting the Rituals.

__NOTOC__ Lord Magmathar is a fire elemental perched atop Thunder Peak in Ashenvale. He has caused an eruption in the forest and want to burn it with his minions. The shaman of the Earthen Ring try to kill him with the help of Arctanus.
__NOTOC__ Lord Overheat is a fire elemental found in Stormwind Stockade.

Lord Raymond George was once the leader of the Argent Dawn. It is unknown exactly how he died, but he returned in his ghostly form to help train new recruits by battling them. He is in the Crypt behind Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands and first summoned during Argent Call: The Trial of the Crypt. Later he will provide the only repeatable reputation quests for the classic Argent Dawn faction, in Scholomance and Stratholme Main Gate (Scarlet Bastion).
Lord Godfrey is an undead former Gilnean noble and the last encounter in the Shadowfang Keep.

Lord Hewell is a nobleman of Gilneas who can be found at Tempest's Reach during the worgen starting experience. Though the eastern lords (Lord Walden and Baron Ashbury) took part in Lord Godfrey's plan to take King Genn Greymane captive in order to bargain with the Forsaken, Hewell refused to betray his king. Instead he remained by Greymane's side until Krennan Aranas sent an adventurer to help.
__NOTOC__ Lord Harford is an Argent Dawn prisoner of the death knights in the Scarlet Enclave.

]] Lord of His Pack is a short story by James Waugh featured on the official site. It is the second in the Leaders of Azeroth series, released on January 14, 2011, and centers on the worgen's King Genn Greymane.
__NOTOC__ .]] Lord Cannon is a fire revenant located at Cannon's Inferno within the Twilight Highlands. After a shaky truce with Countess Verrall, he is now against her.

Lord Rhyolith is a magma giant boss of the Firelands raid instance. During The Sanctuary Must Not Fall, he appears at the Sanctuary of Malorne on Mount Hyjal. World first heroic kill on 25-man achieved 5.7.2011 by Premonition - US-Sen'Jin.
Loramus' Head is a quest item for Not Just Any Body. It is found in a Dreadmaul Cache in the Blasted Lands.
Loramus' Torso is a quest item for Not Just Any Body. It is found in a Dreadmaul Cache in the Blasted Lands.
Loramus' Legs are a quest item for Not Just Any Body. It is found in the Dreadmaul Cache in the Blasted Lands.

Lore for Noobs was created to make the lore in World of Warcraft more accessible to a wide audience. The videos are presented in bite sized chunks, they use cards to display important characters, zones, items, races, factions and events. Cards are available on the Deviantart. Most episodes are voiced by Pride himself.
Lordaeron Sentries are humans located in Old Hillsbrad Foothills.

Lordaeron Watchmen are soldiers of the kingdom of Lordaeron in the Old Hillsbrad Foothills. It is interesting to note that they share their uniform with the Hillsbrad Sentries of the modern Hillsbrad Foothills.

The Lordaeron Captain was a human footman of the 1st Legion. No one knows who he is. It is believed he may have been Captain Luc Valonforth or Marwyn. Either way, he still suffered a fate worse than death.
Lordaeron Footsoldiers were human footmen of the 1st Legion. These poor souls were the ones who followed Arthas to Northrend. They met their end when Arthas decided to create his army of the damned.
Lorbu Sadsummon is a gnome found overlooking the Wreck of Hellscream's Fist in the Jade Forest.
The Lordaeron Lambic is an alcoholic drink from Lordaeron. It is unknown who is still brewing these considering the fall of the kingdom.
__NOTOC__ Loramus the Defiler is Loramus Thalipedes possessed by a demon located in the Blasted Lands.

__NOTOC__ Lord Geoffery Tulvan is a worgen located at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands. He is one of the challengers and seeks to become the greatest warrior in the world. He is strong enough to lift his own carriage. Once he turns, he is known as Lord Geoffery Wildwolf. He summons three servants.
The Lordaeron Crier is a human footman who appears in the Culling of Stratholme. He announces the ten waves as well as the bosses.
Lordaeron Footmen are human footmen who appear in the Culling of Stratholme. They assist Arthas during the purge. They are also seen in The Deaths of Chromie.

__NOTOC__ Lorekeeper Amberwind is a Highborne night elf located at the Darnassian Base Camp in Azshara. She appears to be in charge of the area, and according to the blood elf Andorel Sunsworn, Amberwind is overseeing the Alliance investigation of the ruins of Azshara. Amberwind is aided in combat by a construct she summons, and various Apprentice Investigators and Apprentice Illuminators, likely her students and assistants, prowl the Base Camp.
__NOTOC__ Lord Blastington's Scope of Doom is a hunter-only scope that has a chance to increase your Agility.
Lopex is a rare fox located north of Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills.
__NOTOC__ Lor-Lor is a hozen located at the Skyrange in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Lords of War is a series of animated shorts telling the backstories of the prominent orc characters from Warlords of Draenor. The stories are told by Vindicator Maraad, who faced all of these orcs before in the main timeline. It is a part of the Savage World literature.

Loranea is a draenei located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Loranea, Voraatios the Benedictive and Bemora have traveled to Stormwind Harbor bringing Light-Infused Crystals from the Exodar for the Alliance champions shipping off to the Broken Shore. Curiously, she is simultaneously present at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the fight.
Lord of the Reins is a Collections achievement earned for learning how to summon 300 different mounts on a single character.
__NOTOC__ Lord Aram'el is an eredar located at the Halls of the Sargerei in .
Lord Brinebeard is a sea giant located on the Temple of a Thousand Lights in Azsuna.
Lord Kra'vos is a doomlord appearing during the battle for the Broken Shore, summoned by . He later appeared in Kun-Lai Summit, attacking the Temple of the White Tiger.

__NOTOC__ Lord Winifred Browne is a human located at Bizmo's Brawlpub in Deeprun Tram alongside Harold G. Goldsprocket. He will allow adventurers to bet on the outcome of current battles, awarding Brawler's Gold.
__NOTOC__ Lord Tash'irel is a spectre located at Nor'Danil Wellspring in Azsuna.
Lord Kalgorath is an eredar appearing during the Assault on Broken Shore scenario as the intermediary boss.

__NOTOC__ Lord Nath'raxas is a man'ari eredar located in Nath'raxas Spire in Krokuun. He had a role in delivering Argus to the Legion many years ago, and as such was rewarded with his own fortress. He is armed with a scythe.
Lore Keeper Projection Units are titan orbs located in Ulduar.
Lord Shalzaru's Relic is a reward from Requesting Reinforcements.
Lorael is a Lost One. He was part of the Moro'gai, a faction that never made it past the beta.
Lord Kormag is a doomguard located at the Storm's Reach in Stormheim during Legion Assaults.

__NOTOC__ Lord Korithis is an eredar found in the Heart of Jade in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Korithis is the leader of the demonic invasion force attacking the temple, the Grandmaster, Monkey King and Priestess Summerpetal fought Korithis while Yu'lon fought his felbat Yigthregor. After the eredar is slain, Yu'lon bestows Fu Zan, the Wanderer's Companion to the Grandmaster.

Lordaeron Commanders were human ghosts that could spawn at the various scout towers in the Eastern Plaguelands. They spawned alongside four Lordaeron Soldiers once the Alliance captured a tower in the A Game of Towers PvP event.

Lordaeron Soldiers were human ghosts that could spawn at the various scout towers in the Eastern Plaguelands. Four of them spawned with a Lordaeron Commander once the Alliance captured a tower in the A Game of Towers PvP event.

Lordaeron Veterans were Forsaken ghosts that could spawn at the various scout towers in the Eastern Plaguelands. They spawned alongside four Lordaeron Fighters once the Horde captured a tower in the A Game of Towers PvP event.

__NOTOC__ Lord Eilgar is a nathrezim summoned from Nathreza to the Halls of the Boundless Reach in Antorus, the Burning Throne by Portal Keeper Hasabel. He is partially obscured from view by the "Mind Fog" effect shrouding his platform.

__NOTOC__ Lord Erdris Thorn is a night elf located at Black Rook Hold. He was a key commander of Kur'talos Ravencrest's forces during the War of the Ancients, and Jarod Shadowsong apparently regarded him as a friend.

__NOTOC__ Loraan is a draenei mage located in Xylem's Tower in Azshara. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he became a member of Xylem's inner circle. When the adventurer confronted the corrupted archmage, he sent his apprentici to deal with them. When Loraan was defeated, a shadow emerged from him and he came to his senses.
Lord Arthur Waycrest was the patriarch and Lord of House Waycrest.
__NOTOC__ Lorekeeper's Summoning Stone can be found at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
Lord and Lady Waycrest are the fourth boss encounter of Waycrest Manor.

Lord Aldrius Norwington is a Kul Tiran noble known for hosting great equestrian and hunting festivals at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound. After the Alliance Emissary rescued Aldrius' son Eddie from Tiragarde's troggs, he welcomed them at Norwington Equestrian and Hunt Festival. He had them practice riding skills on Cooper and then asked them to retrieve Rose for him. Unfortunately at that moment, the estate was attacked by Grimestone troggs. Aldrius had the adventurer thin the enemy numbers, saving the estate and festival.
__NOTOC__ Lord Nimrod is a nightborne noble who was invited to participate in the hunt for Volpin. Class order champions questioned him about the event and stole his invitation.
Lord Ashvane was lord of House Ashvane and husband of Priscilla. He died during the Invasion of Durotar.

Lorash Sunbeam was a Horde operative who oversaw the assault on Astranaar in Ashenvale during the War of the Thorns. He and a Horde champion assassinated the guards of the town. He was killed by Malfurion Stormrage when he tried and failed to assassinate the archdruid. Sometime afterwards, he was resurrected by the Val'kyr as a Forsaken and joined the Horde war effort in the Battle for Darkshore.

Lord Admiral's Rest is the royal crypt of Boralus, where the deceased members of House Proudmoore and the past Lord Admirals of the nation rest. It is situated in the gardens on the south side of Proudmoore Keep and guarded by a few Admiral's Elite Guards.
Lord of Flames is a Destruction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Burning Hunger trait.
Lord Kenning's Signet is a quest reward from Noble Responsibilities.
__NOTOC__ Lor'danel Citizens were found in Lor'danel in Darkshore during the second chapter of the War of the Thorns.
Lord Sharptooth drops from Bramblethorn in Drustvar for Bramblethorn (quest).
Lord Waycrest's Signet drops from Lord and Lady Waycrest in Waycrest Manor.

Lor'danel Landing is a new camp established by the Horde in Darkshore after the War of the Thorns and the blighting of the night elf town of Lor'danel. It is located on the shore of the Veiled Sea, just west of Lor'danel, within the region called Mist's Edge. It is occupied by the Forsaken.
The Lord Admiral's Footlocker is a chest located in the Siege of Boralus. It contains many effects that belonged to Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore.
Lord Pythas' Pauldrons drop from Lord Pythas in the Wailing Caverns.
The Zaetar-kin Wristwraps drop from Lord Vyletongue at the Vyletongue Seat in Maraudon.
Loqh'wa the Vengeful is a tauren located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Lord Bruse is a Forsaken located in Darkshore during the Battle for Darkshore.
Lord Inquisitor Sivius is an inquisitor who would appear in the Felsoul Hold in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Lord Sylysthrel is a nightborne who can be fought in Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena after using Challenge Card: Lord Sylysthrel.
Lord Underfoot is the name found on a grave behind the house of Donni Anthania in Elwynn Forest.
Lord Azi is a Zandalari troll located in the Crypt of the First King in Kings' Rest.
Lord Aldrius' Greatstaff is a quest reward from No Party Like a Trogg Party.
Looted Bleeding Hollow Treasures are a sack and a chest located in Tanaan Jungle.
The Lord of Locks is a mawsworn located in the Fracture Chambers in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Lord Andrei is a venthyr located in the Iremoore Estate in Revendreth.
__NOTOC__ Lord Ionel is a venthyr located behind the Iremoore Estate in Revendreth. He is found talking with Lady Zina.
Lord Neculai is a venthyr located in the Sinfang Parlor in Revendreth.
Lord Vasile is a venthyr located in the Redelav District in Revendreth. He can be found walking back and forth with a Redelav Dredger between the Sinfang Parlor and the Redelav Hall.
Lord Darion is a venthyr located in the Redelav Hall in Revendreth.
Lord Stefan is a venthyr located in the Sourwine Estate in Revendreth.

Lord Sorin is a venthyr located outside the Primrose Residence in the Redelav District in Revendreth. He can be found absolving an Abject Soul of its past sins, occasionally spawning various memories.
Lord Razvan is a venthyr located in the Duskmire Domain in Revendreth.
Lord Silviu is a venthyr located at the Briarbane Stables in Revendreth. He can be found talking with Lady Daniela.
Lord Aurel is a venthyr located in the Darkvein Villa in Revendreth.
__NOTOC__ Lord Blackbale is a venthyr located at Chalice District in Revendreth, standing next to Bolt. He is a treasonous leader of the Blackbale house, in league with Maldraxxi forces.

Lord Chamberlain is a venthyr servant of Sire Denathrius. One of the Master's chief servants, he wielded considerable influence thanks to this station. He was also very prideful, constantly looking down on everyone besides the Master, regardless of their position. He is first met in Pridefall Hamlet in Revendreth where he enlists the adventurer to serve Denathrius. After the adventurer joins Sinfall, the Lord Chamberlain serves as the final boss of the Halls of Atonement, where he meets his end.
Lords of Torment are located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Lord Herne is the leader of the Wild Hunt and a quest giver in Ardenweald. In contrast to Ardenweald's more playful denizens, Herne is a stoic and solemn old soldier. He is easily recognized by his eyepatch and large horns.
Lopwogs are toads located in the Dusty Burrows in Ardenweald.
Lord Garridan is a venthyr located in Sinfall in Revendreth.
Lord Scowl is a venthyr located in Ember Ward in Revendreth.
Lord Renard is a vulpin Wild God located in Renard's Den in Ardenweald.
Lora is a sylvar located at the Hibernal Hollow in Ardenweald.
Lord Holscher is a venthyr located in the Sinposium in Revendreth.
Lord Herne's Report is provided for and an objective of Unbroken Bonds, part of the Night Fae Campaign.
Lords of Anguish are located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Lord Amalthwyn is a sylvar located at Grove of Awakening in Ardenweald.
Lord Mortegore is a boneguard located at Death's End in Revendreth. To summon him, kill Maldraxxi Defectors to loot Mortegore Scroll, needed to activate four Mortegore Sigils.
Lord Chamberlain's Cloak is a quest reward from Halls of Atonement: Your Absolution.
Lord Dretnal is a Mawsworn construct located at the Crucible of the Damned in the Maw during the Night Fae Assault. An objective of Double Dromans, Droman Tashmur is fighting off the construct.

Lore in Short is a series of animated shorts offering quick recaps of parts of Warcraft lore as promotion for World of Warcraft: Classic, with narration set to new artwork by Bayard Wu. The first two episodes were released for Burning Crusade Classic, with the first episode being posted on June 1, 2021 (the day of Burning Crusade Classics release), and are both voiced by an unnamed narrator. The third episode was released on September 20, 2022, a week before the release of Wrath of the Lich King Classic, and is narrated by Jaina Proudmoore (Laura Bailey).
Lord Azzorak is a nathrezim located at the Vault of Secrets in Korthia. Xy'lonu at Keeper's Respite is offering a bounty for Azzorak in the daily group quest Broker's Bounty: Lord Azzorak.
The Lord of Shade's Binders drop from Torglluun in the Rift in The Maw.
Lor the Loyal was a shadehound serving Warden Skoldus in Skoldus Hall in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Lord Harris is a venthyr located in Pridefall Hamlet in Revendreth.
The Lords of Dread, Mal'Ganis and Kin'tessa, are the ninth boss encounter of the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
__NOTOC__ Lord Stavros is a venthyr located in the Feast of Arrogance in Castle Nathria, as part of the Council of Blood encounter.
Lord Ander is a venthyr located in Redelav Tower in Revendreth.
Lord Le is a venthyr located in Redelav Tower in Revendreth.
Loquacious Keeper's Peridot drops from Lihuvim in Sepulcher of the First Ones.

Lordaeron Blight is a slime giant located at the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus. It is the living manifestation of the blight suffusing the Ruins of Lordaeron, brought to life by Plague Deviser Marileth.
__NOTOC__ Lord Basilton is a quest reward from Carry On, Basilton in the Gardens of Unity of Thaldraszus.
__NOTOC__ Lord Epochbrgl is a murloc located in Thaldraszus.

Looter's Purses drop one time only from Crazed Looters near Shomko's Remembrance on the Coast of Echoes on the western shore of the Borean Tundra after turning in Shomko's Unyielding Spear. The purse contains roughly .
Lord Stantley is obtained by interacting with the Curious Top Hat in Zaralek Cavern while under the effect of Clacking Claw.
Lord Admiral's Signet drops from Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Battle of Dazar'alor.
Lord Valthalak's Staff of Command dropped from Lord Valthalak in Upper Blackrock Spire.

__NOTOC__ The Lost Soul is a rare ghost found roaming a small area by Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades. She is one of the many banshees of the Scourge that are still loyal to the Lich King and remains under his control. She is on a 1-2 hour respawn timer, however, it is possible for several to be out at the same time. Her and Tormented Spirits' appearance may be connected.
The Lorespinner was a reward from the following quests: *Lethtendris's Web (quest)

Lotwil Veriatus is a gnome located in a small camp just east of Kargath in the Badlands. He is a scholar of some renown in the field of elemental sciences. Lotwil and the goblin Bro'kin are good friends.

The Lost Ones (sometimes also spelled in lower case) are highly mutated and deformed draenei. They have devolved further than the Broken and many have been reduced to savage and primitive beasts. It is hinted that the name was given to them by the draenei in Outland, long before they came to Azeroth, because it was believed that their minds had become "lost". Despite having devolved and being nicknamed "lost ones" they may still be referred to as draenei.
Lotherias is a night elf quest giver located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Lost Point is a run-down, decrepit scout tower built by the humans of Theramore. It is located in western Dustwallow Marsh, and is currently inhabited by Theramore deserters. Balos Jacken is these deserters' leader, and has information about Private Hendel's part in the kidnapping of a very important personality.
The Lorgalis Manuscript is a Twilight text sought after by Sentinel-trainee Issara in the quest Knowledge in the Deeps.
__NOTOC__ Lost Barrens Kodo are kodo found around the four oases in the Northern Barrens.

__NOTOC__ Loremaster Dibbs was a human quest giver located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He didn't seem impressed at what the Crushridge ogres may have done to the various books and tomes still located within the Ruins of Alterac. After the Cataclysm, he escaped the Forsaken's plague-bombing of Southshore and has taken refuge in Fenris Keep. He accepts Darius Crowley's offer to become a worgen in order to immunise himself from the Forsaken's curse of undeath. He sides with the Gilneas Liberation Front during the Battle of Silverpine. During the battle, he engages a force of Forsaken mages along side Phin Odelic. Both are eventually slain in the ensuing conflict.
The Lost One Chieftain is a rare mob Lost One found in the Shifting Mire of the Swamp of Sorrows. He is presumably the only leader left of the group.
The Lost One Cook is a rare lost one cook of the Lost Ones in the Shifting Mire of the Swamp of Sorrows.
__NOTOC__ Loro is an jungle troll ghost found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Lost One Hunters are 36-37 Lost Ones that can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Lost One Mudlurkers are Lost Ones be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Lost One Rift Travelers are Lost Ones summoned by Lost One Riftseeker in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Lost One Seers are Lost Ones that can be found in Swamp of Sorrows.
Lost One Riftseekers are Lost Ones found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Loreskin Shoulders are a quest reward from Return to Apothecary Zinge.
Lorti is a jungle troll reagent vendor located at Swamprat Post in Zangarmarsh.
Lost Anchorite's Cloak is a quest reward from The Cleansing Must Be Stopped.
The Lost Supplies were contained in Scattered Crates in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Lotwil's Shackles of Elemental Binding dropped from the Fam'retor Guardian in the Badlands.
Lost Torranches are tallstriders found at Sorrow Wing Point in Terokkar Forest.

Lou the Cabin Boy is a tauren near Kamagua in Howling Fjord. He will carry you over to Scalawag Point as part of a tuskarr quest chain. He seems to be in a group with "Tiny" Jimb, Grezzix Spindlesnap and Grezzix's parrot Molly.
Lothalor Ancients are are ancients of War found in the Lothalor Woodlands in the Dragonblight.

__NOTOC__ Loremaster of Eastern Kingdoms is a meta quest achievement earned for completing the Eastern Kingdoms quest achievements. that is itself part of the larger meta-achievement The Loremaster. It requires the player to complete certains zones of Eastern Kingdoms. Like the other quest achievements, the zones a character must complete differs depending on if the character is Alliance or Horde.

Loremaster of Kalimdor is a meta-achievement that is itself part of the larger meta-achievement The Loremaster. It requires the player to complete a certain number of quests in each zone of Kalimdor. Like the other quest achievements, the number of quests a character must complete per zone differs depending on if the character is Alliance or Horde.

Loremaster of Outland is a meta quest achievement earned for completing the required Outland quest achievements. It requires the player to complete a certain number of quests in each zone of Outland. Like the other quest achievements, the number of quests a character must complete per zone differs depending on if the character is Alliance or Horde.

Loremaster of Northrend is a meta quest achievement that is itself part of the larger meta-achievement The Loremaster. It requires the player to complete a certain number of quests in each zone of Northrend, with the exceptions of Crystalsong Forest and Wintergrasp. Like the other quest achievements, the number of quests a character must complete per zone differs depending on if the character is Alliance or Horde (altogether: 875 quests for all players).

The Lost Vrykul Signet is a quest reward from The Frost Wyrm and its Master.

Lorsty is a former Community MVP for the Latin American World of Warcraft since March 13th 2009 and he's normally encountered on the [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/ US Latin American Forums], specifically the [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?forumId=20003&sid=2 Latin American Customer Service Forum]. Lorsty began his posting career as a blood elf death knight, but he is known to have many different characters, most of them blood elves. He likes chocolate and cookies.

Lost Hope was the name of a ship once commanded by Captain Edward Hanes. It is just one of many ships over the thousands of years since the Great Sundering that have been sunk by the bloodcurse and Bloodcursed naga.
The Lost Passage is a hidden road leading north out of the Borean Tundra into southwestern Sholazar Basin that connects with the southern circuit of the Path of the Lifewarden.

__NOTOC__ The Lost Lands is a large blighted area overrun by undead covering much of eastern Sholazar Basin. It reaches to the Rainspeaker Rapids and stretches from the lands surrounding the fallen Lifeblood Pillar to the Makers' Overlook. During the war against the Lich King, the Lifeblood Pillar was sabotaged by the Cult of the Damned and fell, which allowed snows from Icecrown to collapse into the basin, creating the Avalanche and giving the Scourge a pathway in the region. The Lost Lands spread out from the Avalanche, it is an area blighted and dying, the air fouled with a yellow haze, the ground thick with Scourge. The hostile Lost Ones who live in the Fallow Sanctuary are simply identified as the "Lost Ones".
Lose Your Illusion (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Thorim while Sif is present on 10-player mode.
The Lost Ring can be found inside the Tiny Titanium Lockbox, found in turn inside the Bag of Fishing Treasures (Dalaran) rewarded from completing Marcia Chase's daily fishing quests in Dalaran.

Loruk Foreststrider is a tauren that could be found at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.

A variety of dinosaur species were to live on the Lost Isles, including spiny raptors and an unnamed, bipedal species with spiked plates covering its body. Pterrordax also roamed the Lost Isle. Shark-like sea creatures were to inhabit the seas around the isle, feeding on lost goblins and the like.
__NOTOC__ Lothan Silverblade is a blood elf warrior trainer located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.

Loremaster of Cataclysm is a meta quest achievement that is part of the meta-achievement The Loremaster. It requires the player to complete a certain number of quests in each new zone added to Azeroth, which were exposed by the Cataclysm. Like the other quest achievements, the number of quests a character must complete per zone differs depending on if the character is Alliance or Horde.
The Lost Caldera is a large volcanic crater found within the great caldera in Lost Peak, on the Lost Isles. Several Children of Volcanoth roam the area near the main entrance into Volcanoth's Lair.

The Lost Son of Arugal is a rare worgen that patrols around Silverpine Forest. With its "father", the Archmage Arugal, and many of its brothers dead, this worgen is left to wander the forest alone. The debuff appears whenever the Lost Son is nearby, making it relatively easy to spot (and avoid, if necessary).
Lorien's Grave is the last resting place of Lorien Sunblaze. It is located at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. His corpse is revealed using the Seer's Crystal during The Stories Dead Men Tell.

:"I am known as a Lorewalker - a kind of historian for my people. As such, knowledge is my armor, and I carry a quill in place of a sword. Much of Pandaria's past is shrouded in mystery, even to us. A Lorewalker's sworn duty is to rediscover our history - to rend that shroud, piece by piece. This demands a tireless search for ancient clues, and the wisdom to interpret them." :— The Lorewalkers are a pandaren faction bent on exploring the world, finding stories, artifacts, and relics to fill out their libraries.

:"Every good story needs a hero!" Lorewalker Cho is the leader of the pandaren Lorewalkers. His kindly demeanor, boundless curiosity and saint-like patience has made him something of an informal ambassador of pandaren culture to the Horde and Alliance. While not a fighter, Cho accompanies the players on numerous adventures throughout Pandaria, usually providing lore and background to current situations. He can be found at various locations in Jade Forest and Kun-Lai Summit, as well as Mogu'shan Vaults. Cho can also be seen during The Wanderer's Festival at Turtle Beach of the Krasarang Wilds. Lotus Farmers are pandaren located at the Pools of Purity in the Valley of the Four Winds. They are working for Zhang Yue.
Lost Mushan are mushan located in Forbidden Jungle in Krasarang Wilds.
The Lorewalker's Map is sold by Tan Shin Tiao at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms for .
The Lorewalker's Lodestone is sold by Tan Shin Tiao at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms for .
Lost Ravagers are ravagers found in Mazthoril in Winterspring.
Lorewalker Pao is a pandaren found at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes. This Lorewalker keeps records of the Shado-Pan's activities.

Loremaster of Pandaria is a meta quest achievement that is part of the meta-achievement The Loremaster. It requires the player to complete the storylines in each new zone in Pandaria. Unlike the other quest achievements, number of quests completed no longer count for quest achievements in Pandaria, and the character must finish the story lines listed for each zone.
Lots of Rarity is a pet battle achievement earned by capturing 10 rare battle pets.
Loremaster Bret is a goblin vendor located at Fuselight-by-the-Sea in the Badlands.

Lorewalker Amai is a pandaren found at the Dawning Span teaching Young Students about the history of Shen-zin Su and Liu Lang. While she narrates the story, Lorewalker Ruolin is singing the song of Liu Lang in old pandaren language.

Lorewalker Ruolin is a pandaren found at the Dawning Span singing the song of Liu Lang in old pandaren language to Young Students during Lorewalker Amai's lesson. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he was located in the Laughing Crane.
Lorewalker Zan is a pandaren found atop of the Dawning Span. When you cross the Span for Morning Breeze Village (quest), he invites you to attend a lesson by Lorewalker Amai.
Lost Offsprings of Gahz'ranka can be found in Zul'Gurub. They are descendants of the original Zul'Gurub optional raid boss Gahz'ranka. They circle around the lake.
Lots 'o Meat Pie can only be bought from Chris Moller in Gilneas.

Lorewalker Shuchun is a Lorewalker who travels around Pandaria in pursuits of knowledge and history, as well as protecting the artifacts from taken. She enjoys telling stories to teach a lesson instead of lecturing. She can be found near the bottom of the Path of a Hundred Steps leading from the Valley of the Four Winds to Kun-Lai Summit. She can also be seen during the Wanderer's Festival at Turtle Beach of Krasarang Wilds.

Lost Dog is a level 90 dog hiding in a sheltered spot in the Heartland in Valley of the Four Winds. He will only appear once you have reached 12600 with the Tillers. After completing his quest he will go to stay at Sunsong Ranch as Dog.
Lorewalker Huynh is an inscription trainer found in the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Lorewalker Chang is a pandaren who was an ancestor of Lorewalker Cho. He is able to be seen during the quest Peering Into the Past.
Lost Gilnean Wardog is a rare mastiff running back and forth between two abandoned campsites to the northeast of Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine Forest.
Losaj is a rare silithid colossus found in the eastern part of the tunnel system of Hive'Zora in Silithus.
Lorgalis is an unknown being fighting for the Twilight's Hammer. The only thing known about him is his description of the Old Gods in Lorgalis Manuscript.

Lorewalker Shin is a pandaren located at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Upon reaching level 91, players may use this NPC to queue for Mists of Pandaria heroic scenarios.
Lorewalker Han is a pandaren located at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Upon reaching level 91, players may use this NPC to queue for Mists of Pandaria raid finder raids.
Lorewalker Chi Chi is a pandaren who is an ancestor of Lorewalker Cho. She is able to be seen during the quest Peering Into the Past.
Lorewalker Cheech is an ancestor of Lorewalker Cho seen during the quest Peering Into the Past.

He gifted a carved bronze mirror to her with the inscription "To my dearest Lin / My beauty, my dove / This picture of perfection / Your reflection / My love - Yao". Loruk the Ancient is a Draenor ancient located around Gorgrond. He will occasionally appear when a medium tree is cut down while on the Legacy of the Ancients quest.

Loremaster of Draenor is a meta quest achievement. It requires the player to complete the storylines in each zone in . Much like Loremaster of Pandaria, Loremaster of Draenor requires completing each storyline in every zone, rather than completing a certain number of quests.

Lothraxion is the High Commander of the Grand Army of the Light, and serves High Exarch Turalyon and Lady Alleria Windrunner, who sent him to Azeroth in order to help protect it from the Burning Legion. He is a nathrezim infused with the Light, and can be found at the Sanctum of Light, the order hall of the Knights of the Silver Hand.
__NOTOC__ Lost Edicts of the Watcher has a very low chance to drop from any demon on the Broken Isles and Argus.
Lost Codex of the Amani may drop from any of the rare mobs in The Underbelly in Dalaran.

The Lost Orchard is a subzone found in Azsuna. It consists of the ruins of the Challiane Vineyards, the property of Lady Challiane. It is now haunted by the ghosts of its former laborers, brewing an arcane-aged wine so awful, it would serve as a decent poison.
Lorlathil is a neutral village found in Val'sharah. The village's residents seem to be mostly druids with night elves, dryads, and keepers of the grove.

__NOTOC__ Lostlight Grotto is a grotto found in Val'sharah. The recent events in the region have turned the owlbeasts into crazed monsters who pervert dryad corpses into oozing minions and have Keeper Remulos imprisoned.

Loremaster of Legion is a meta quest achievement. It requires the player to complete the storylines in each zone on the Broken Isles. Much like Loremaster of Draenor, Loremaster of Legion requires completing each storyline in every zone, rather than completing a certain number of quests.

Lorena Belle is a worgen who can be found in the Uncrowned Vault in the Hall of Shadows. She is able to refund the traits in the players artifact. She joined Wrathion's cause and traveled to the Dragon Isles. She is found as his quartermaster at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
